  • Classes in com.hkust.marketplace.ui used by com.hkust.marketplace.ui
    Class
    Description
    ChatView
    The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the history of messages and offers with sender and time, a box to write a message, and a search of the history that jumps to the chosen message and highlights it.
    ChatView.AgreeToCounter
    What the buyer's Agree to Counter does with the countered offer they chose: Make Offer with the counter's terms filled in (UC5 step 1 and Special Requirement 4).
    ChatView.RespondToOffers
    What the seller's Respond in Offers & Requests does: the seller portal shows its Manage Offers & Requests screen with these offers marked (Scrolling.JUMP_HIGHLIGHT) and the newest one scrolled into view (Scrolling.bringIntoView(javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane, javafx.scene.Node)), as a chat search result is (UC6 A2 step 4).
    ContentHost
    Somewhere a screen can be shown: each portal's dashboard, whose main area shows one screen at a time.
    ListingCard
    The listing card, the same in all three portals (non-functional requirement: shared components for cards).
    ListingSummary
    What a listing card shows, worked out once from a listing and the store.
    ListingSummary.Field
    One named value on the listing detail screen, such as "Condition" and "Used".
    Refreshable
    A screen that can reload its data while it is open, for example after the borrowing-deadline timer returned an item (UC12 step 4: the change shows on the open My Deals screen).
